Let $A(-2,0)$ and $B(3,3).$ Find $|\overset{\to }{AB}|.$ Do not round the answer.

$|\overset{\to }{AB}|=$
{{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
We have 

$$
\begin{aligned} & \overset{\to }{OA}=a=-2i+0j, \\  & \overset{\to }{OB}=b=3i+3j.\end{aligned}
$$

Expressing $\overset{\to }{AB}$ as the difference of position vectors, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =\overset{\to }{OB}-\overset{\to }{OA} \\  & =b-a \\  & =(3i+3j)-(-2i+0j) \\  & =5i+3j.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|\overset{\to }{AB}| & =\sqrt{{5}^{2}+{3}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{25+9} \\  & =\sqrt{34}.\end{aligned}
$$
